title: scholtzia obovata
intro: Scholtzia obovata, commonly known as the yellow buttons or lemon-scented button bush, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Rutaceae family. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Scholtzia obovata may include antioxidant, anti-histaminic, and anti-fungal actions. Bioactive constituents of the plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
